description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into a Salesforce SObject via the native External-ID upsert endpoint. `PATCH /services/data/vXX.0/sobjects/{Object}/{ExtIdField}/{Value}` atomically creates or updates in one request — no search-then-write. Composite mode batches 200 records per HTTP call for high throughput.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row → one Salesforce record (upserted via external_id_field).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored / composite_batching). No downstream data — the write side effect lands in Salesforce.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

sobject.label: SObject
sobject.description: Target Salesforce SObject API name (Account / Contact / Opportunity / CustomThing__c).

external_id_field.label: External Id Field
external_id_field.description: SObject field marked as 'External ID' in Salesforce (used as the upsert match key).

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column → Salesforce field API name.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap).

use_composite.label: Use Composite
use_composite.description: Use /composite/sobjects for 200-record batching (ignored when use_bulk: true).

composite_all_or_none.label: Composite All-or-None
composite_all_or_none.description: If true, Salesforce rolls back the whole 200-record batch on any error.

use_bulk.label: Use Bulk 2.0
use_bulk.description: Use the async Bulk 2.0 ingest API — 10-100x faster for >200-row loads.

bulk_poll_interval_seconds.label: Bulk Poll Interval (s)
bulk_poll_interval_seconds.description: How often to poll Bulk 2.0 job status (only used when use_bulk: true).

bulk_poll_timeout_seconds.label: Bulk Poll Timeout (s)
bulk_poll_timeout_seconds.description: Max wait for Bulk 2.0 job completion (only used when use_bulk: true).

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily' / 'weekly' / 'monthly' / 'hourly' / 'static' / 'multi' / 'dynamic' / None. A partitioned run sends only the rows in its partition (see partition_date_column / partition_static_column).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter the rows to send to the current date partition key.
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter the rows to send to the current static partition value.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

name: Salesforce Record Upsert
